title: StoryLens 1.3.4 macOS 安装包与平台适配
user_summary: 为 Apple Silicon 与 Intel Mac 提供 1.3.4 DMG 构建，并补齐本地服务、数据目录、外链与 PDF 浏览器的平台适配。
technical_summary: 新增双架构 macOS GitHub Actions 构建、PyInstaller sidecar/DMG 冒烟门禁，并使数据目录、sidecar 生命周期、外部购买链接和 Chromium PDF 查找跨平台。
acceptance_criteria: Apple Silicon runner produces a mountable arm64 DMG containing StoryLens.app and executable storylens-api.
Intel runner produces a mountable x64 DMG containing StoryLens.app and executable storylens-api.
Packaged sidecar boots on loopback, passes /health, and exits through the authenticated shutdown endpoint.
No API key, Apple signing credential, license private key, or user database is included in build artifacts.
verification_evidence: Windows targeted platform tests and Rust unit tests passed before macOS CI dispatch.

data_compatibility.notes: No database migration. Windows paths remain unchanged; macOS uses ~/Library/Application Support/StoryLens.
